# Jig and FLOW

Jig is a local, secure host for admitted FLOW packages.

- Landing page: https://flow.jig.md/
- Documentation map: https://flow.jig.md/docs/
- Source and quickstart: https://github.com/jigmd/jig#readme
- FLOW Package/1: https://github.com/jigmd/jig/blob/main/docs/spec/package-format.md
- FLOW Run/1: https://github.com/jigmd/jig/blob/main/docs/spec/run-protocol.md
- FLOW Run SDK/1: https://github.com/jigmd/jig/blob/main/docs/spec/run-sdk.md
- FLOW Schema/1: https://github.com/jigmd/jig/blob/main/docs/spec/schema-files.md
- Jig project policy: https://github.com/jigmd/jig/blob/main/docs/spec/project-policy.md
- Security boundary: https://github.com/jigmd/jig/blob/main/SECURITY.md
